positive: A critical remote code execution vulnerability in Apache Log4j 2 JNDI lookup functionality allowing unauthenticated command injection via crafted strings.
Adversaries abuse PowerShell command-line interfaces and scripting environments to execute arbitrary malicious code and perform system discovery.
A credential theft technique targeting the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe) memory space to extract plaintext passwords and Kerberos tickets.
A lateral movement technique where adversaries leverage legitimate administrator credentials to access hidden shares like ADMIN$ and C$ over SMB.
A WinRAR processing flaw where interacting with a crafted archive triggers automatic execution of embedded scripts disguised as legitimate file formats.
